name: Amoxicillin trihydrate
description: Amoxicillin trihydrate (CAS 61336-70-7 ) is a broad-spectrum beta-lactam antibiotic active pharmaceutical ingredient used in the manufacture of finished oral and injectable dosage forms. It serves as the primary antibacterial agent in a wide range of prescription drug products. This essential compound targets bacterial infections across human and veterinary medicine. In human pharmaceutical manufacturing, it is compounded into capsules, tablets, and oral suspensions, which are among the highest-volume antibiotic dosage forms produced globally. Veterinary drug manufacturers incorporate it into formulations for livestock and companion animals. In these applications, it effectively addresses respiratory, urinary, and soft tissue bacterial infections to ensure animal health and safety. It is also used in the production of combination products, most notably paired with clavulanic acid. This combination is designed to overcome bacterial resistance in augmented antibiotic formulations used in clinical settings. Amoxicillin trihydrate is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Standard grades include USP , BP , and Ph. Eur. , with compendial specifications governing particle size, potency, and residual solvent limits. These quality standards are relevant to finished dosage form performance and regulatory compliance.
